title: Native account workspace isolation
description: Launch the private app with the original admin profile selected and the second owner profile already provisioned. Supply the nonsecret NATIVE_OWNER_TRANSITION_FIXTURE, private administrator credential, existing native session, simulator and evidence directory. Uses native controls and one retained read-only inspector to prove account transitions, history isolation and request boundaries. Profile seeding does not prove the credential-entry form.

transitions.intent: Owner controls preserve the active workspace and its retained native session.
